findings.text: The mirror check used to be a no-op and now actually enforces the regex `^https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]+$`. That character set has no `:`, `~`, `%`, `@` or `+`. A legitimate mirror such as `NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080/dist` or `http://mirror.local:3000` now fails with 'may only contain a URL' and returns 2, so every nvm command that calls `nvm_get_mirror` breaks for those users.
